_meta.description: Translator-context sidecar for auth.common. Shared shell strings used across login, signup, forgot password, reset password, invite, and workspace selection pilots.
_meta.audience: End users completing authentication and workspace selection.
_meta.tone: Concise, neutral, professional. Avoid casual contractions where they could confuse non-English readers.

actions._use: Verbs for form/page actions. Translate as imperative verbs.

fields._use: Form field labels and placeholders. Keep length close to the English source so inputs do not collapse on narrow viewports.
fields.emailPlaceholder: Sample email shown inside the input. The trailing ellipsis indicates the field is editable.

loading._use: Status copy shown on transient loading screens.
loading.redirecting: Shown while the auth shell is about to redirect an already-authenticated user.
loading.loadingLogin: Shown while the login surface is hydrating.

routeSwitch.ariaLabel: Accessible name for the login/signup tab switcher; not visible.
routeSwitch.login: Tab label that takes users to /login.
routeSwitch.signup: Tab label that takes users to /signup.
routeSwitch.back: Default label for the back button used on auxiliary auth screens (forgot password, reset password).

divider._use: Divider copy that sits between the email/password form and the OAuth provider buttons. Rendered uppercase via CSS — translators do not need to change case. Keep ≤ 24 chars after translation so the divider stays balanced on narrow viewports.
divider.orContinueWith: Shown above the OAuth provider buttons (Google, GitHub, etc.) on /login and /signup.
